payload.acceptance_criteria:
When a benchmark run has no token total, its token value shall stay unknown, it shall be excluded from every cost total, and the report shall name the runs it excluded.
When a timing metric is missing, the aggregate shall not count it as zero.
payload.description:
## Context
When a skill benchmark run has no token total, I want the cost to stay unknown, so I can trust the benchmark cost totals.
Finding of codex-1, 2026-11-13: in the skill-creator skill, aggregate_benchmark.py lines 55 to 64 default missing timing metrics to zero, and read_run at line 100 uses execution_metrics.output_chars as the token value when a token total is missing. Fixture: output_chars=17 and no token total gave tokens=17; with total_tokens=23 it gave 23. Decided by the orchestrator 2026-11-13. No build now.
payload.title: Keep a missing token total unknown in the skill benchmark instead of counting characters as tokens
